title: New PANTY & STOCKING with GARTERBELT
synopsis:
The Bitches Are Back!!

In Daten City, a realm between heaven and hell, sinister spirits known as "Ghosts" prowl the streets, feeding on human desires and resentment. Yet, in the darkest moments, two figures emerge to obliterate these vengeful beings with a divine light beyond human understanding. Their names? Panty & Stocking! These fallen angel sisters have been tasked with purging the darkness engulfing the earth. But who are they, really? Are they truly messengers of God... or agents of the Devil? 

(Source: New PANTY & STOCKING with GARTERBELT Official Site)

 Note: Unveiled at Anime Expo 2022's "TRIGGER 10 YEAR ANNIVERSARY & ANNOUNCEMENT" panel.

episodes.title: Panty & Stocking: Homecoming
episodes.synopsis: Continuing from the cliffhanger in the previous season, Garterbelt, Brief, and Chuck team up with Scanty and Kneesocks to resurrect Panty and stop an out-of-control Stocking.

episodes.title: BITCH GIRLS 4LIFE/The Bodycard
episodes.synopsis: Garterbelt has Panty, Stocking, Scanty and Knee Socks search all over Daten City for a ghost made of water and oil. Later, in order to pay off three trillion Daten City dollars worth of bills Panty competes in a card game in order to get a rare card that is worth the exact amount needed to pay the bills.
